text: {Name}, a bookkeeper from {Place}, kept records for a resistance cell but left after its leader ordered the bookkeeper's friend beaten as an informer. The leader had no evidence.
self_review: The bookkeeper left a resistance cell after its leader ordered a friend beaten on an unsupported accusation of informing.
source_pattern: The supplied Manning interview describes underground analysis of possible informants; it does not establish this wrongful accusation.
fictional_changes: The bookkeeper, cell records, falsely accused friend, punishment order, and departure are fictional. The source supports only the existence of suspicion and information work.
